authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.roleLimits: Per-record role and length values are observed in this source and correlated with LibreDWG 0.14, not generalized across files.

observation.extension: Dictionary 0x110, owner 0x98, has four ordered TILE entries. Its owner is role 12 length 1, and item references role 2 length 2.
observation.records: 0x111 owner role 8 length 0; 0x112/0x113/0x114 owner role 12 length 1. All reactors use role 4 length 2 to 0x110. The exact records contain groups 270=1 and 271=1 and four witnessed final set bits.
observation.sourceBinding: The importing adapter binds the Global MATERIAL frame and EED to its same-import APPID source and the dictionary/XRECORD frames to their source publications and typed baselines. Complete dictionary membership is required for each child.

controls: Different adapter, changed dictionary owner/name/member, XRECORD owner or payload, mutated body/handle-stream bits, missing source-profile binding and per-record truncation are refused; restoring each passes on the same importer.
Aerial APPID, seven MATERIAL EED and 36 TILE source controls continue to pass.

limits: This source proof does not establish APPID_CONTROL physical membership, the complete 0x72 material root or all unrelated drawing dependencies.
The staged writer, output ownership/remapping, signed EED readback and native semantics remain unqualified; no output support claim is promoted.
